summary_en: The video showcases the river landscapes of the Mekong Delta and the water hyacinth weaving livelihood model established by the Disabled Women's Club in Tan Bang commune, Thoi Binh district, Ca Mau province. It features the collection and preparation of natural materials, the manual braiding process of crafting bags, baskets, and mats, alongside personal stories of overcoming hardships, earning income, and community integration.
